source: After Effects export, 1920x1080, 30 fps, bold text translating along x, no other transforms
howMeasured: Frame 5 of the export. The frame-time instance renders sharp at full opacity, so the ink > 0.97 bounding box tracks the word exactly; the duplicates show up as a staircase of plateaus across a vertical stroke. Rows 470 / 540 / 600 agree.
comment:displacements: Core-centre travel from frame 4 to 5 and from 5 to 6. Measured ghost reach past the core is 128 px trailing and 189 px leading (both include the anti-aliased edge), i.e. the window ends land on the neighbouring frames' positions.
comment:edges: Rising edges of the leading stroke's duplicates on the trailing tail, row 470, outermost first; the sharp instance's edge closes the run. Mean spacing 15.6 px against a 125.8 px frame displacement = 1/8 frame per duplicate.
comment:opacity: Plateau heights across the trailing staircase, as a fraction of the sharp text intensity: 0.07 0.13 0.20 0.26 0.32 0.38. Flat, not tapered toward the window edge, and no duplicate approaches full opacity.
